command.help.player:
%0%&ePlayer commands:
&f/crown &7Open the Crown main menu
&f/crown shop &7Open the title shop
&f/crown warehouse &7Open your title warehouse
&f/crown custom &7Create and purchase a custom title
&f/crown buy <title-id> &7Open a product purchase screen
&f/crown equip <entry-id> &7Equip a warehouse title
&f/crown unequip &7Unequip your title
&f/crown delete <entry-id> &7Delete your warehouse entry
&f/crown coin balance &7View your title-coin balance
&f/crown card redeem &7Redeem a title card in hand
command.help.admin:
%0%&eAdmin commands:
&f/crown info &7Show version, storage and product counts
&f/crown reload &7Reload configuration, languages and GUIs
&f/crown player &7Manage player titles and selections
&f/crown view &7Inspect players or products
&f/crown storage &7Inspect or maintain storage
&f/crown audit &7View administrative audit records
&f/crown coin &7Manage title coins
&f/crown title &7Manage shop products
command.help.title-admin:
%0%&eProduct administration:
&f/crown title create <id> &7Create a product
&f/crown title list &7List products
&f/crown title edit <id> &7Edit product text and permission
&f/crown title enable/disable <id> &7Enable or disable a product
&f/crown title delete <id> &7Delete the definition without deleting purchase history
&f/crown title duration <id> &7Edit duration
&f/crown title payment <id> &7Set FREE, MINT or TITLE_COIN payment
&f/crown title stock/limit <id> &7Set stock and per-player limits
&f/crown title sale-start/sale-end <id> &7Set the sale window
